headline: Approved student handbooks, staff hiring authorization, administrator and teacher nominations, policy changes, and donations for 2026-2027.
summary: The committee approved the 26-27 student handbooks, authorization to hire staff before the start of the school year, and several staff nominations and reassignments. It also approved minutes, a financial report, extra-duty assignments, policy revisions, and donations to Cameron Stadium and Bangor High School Boosters.
decisions: Approved adjustments to the agenda, adding items D.1.b. Authorization and E.1.e. Donations, 6-0.
Approved authorization for the Superintendent to hire staff between August 12, 2026 and September 10, 2026 to ensure full staffing, 6-0.
Approved the draft Minutes of the July 15, 2026 Regular School Committee Meeting, 6-0.
Approved the Unaudited June 2026 Financial Report, 6-0.
Approved the administrator nomination of Kelley Bean as Interim Assistant Principal at James F. Doughty School for 2026-2027 with a one-year probationary contract, 6-0.
Approved teacher nominations for the 2026-2027 school year with one-year probationary contracts, 6-0.
Approved extra-duty assignments for the 2026-2027 School Year, 6-0.
Approved the second reading of Revised Policy GCEA - Substitute Compensation Guide, 6-0.

Approved donations including building materials for Cameron Stadium from Hammond Lumber valued at $8,000 and materials and labor from Maine Fire Protection for a Hood Suppression System valued at $6,500, 6-0.

Approved First Reading of Revised Policy IHBAC - Child Find for Special Education and/or Related Aids and Services, and Revised Policy JLF - Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting, Prevention, and Education, 6-0.
